con_blood_potion.name: Blood Potion
con_blood_potion.description: A cracked vial filled with dark crimson fluid of unknown origin. It tastes of iron and regret — but the wounds close fast.

acc_blood_ring.name: Blood Ring
acc_blood_ring.description: A gold band set with a deep crimson gem. It pulses faintly — like a heartbeat that isn't yours.

arm_chained_iron_greaves.name: Chained Iron Greaves
arm_chained_iron_greaves.description: Heavy iron boots bound in rusted chains. Each step echoes like a death knell. The weight slows you — but nothing will knock you down.

acc_crimson_band.name: Crimson Band
acc_crimson_band.description: An oversized ring carved from bone and gold. Wearing it feels like something is being slowly drained from within — yet your strikes grow faster and fiercer.

wp_cursed_iron_sword.name: Cursed Iron Sword
wp_cursed_iron_sword.description: A blade forged in cursed iron, etched with blood runes that hunger for life. Its edge never dulls — but neither does its thirst.

con_dark_mana_potion.name: Dark Mana Potion
con_dark_mana_potion.description: A swirling vial of deep violet liquid, brewed from shadow herbs and crushed night crystal. Restores mana with an unsettling warmth.

con_raw_meat.name: Raw Meat
con_raw_meat.description: Can be cooked or eaten raw if you are desperate.

arm_shadow_legguards.name: Shadow Legguards
arm_shadow_legguards.description: Lightweight guards that seem to absorb the light around them.

arm_skull_helmet.name: Skull Helmet
arm_skull_helmet.description: A helmet fashioned from the skull of a large beast.

arm_warmog_armor.name: Warmog Armor
arm_warmog_armor.description: A legendary chestplate pulsing with vital energy.
